content: उद्वृत् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To go upwards, ascend. .²2 To fly asunder, burst out; उद्वर्तमानमूलबन्धनम् <ls>U. 4</ls> the strings of which are giving way or being snapped. .²3 To tumble over, fall down. .²4 To go out, depart. .²5 To rise, swell, increase. .²6 To be puffed up with pride, be haughty. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To extirpate, eradicate, destroy; उद्वर्तितं रसान्तरेण लज्जालुत्वम् <ls>Mv. 2</ls>. .²2 To throw up, elevate. .²3 To turn round, roll (as eyes). .²4 To anoint, smear. .²5 To beat to pieces, split, burst; अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः <ls>Rv. 8. 14. 13</ls>.
